contents.text: Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. Here is the website piece, the one with an agent in its corner. You start with a short call with Louis, and he makes the quote for your business after that. Shall I pass your details on to him?

arguments.question: How would you like to go on?

choices.label: Pass me on to Louis
choices.why: I take your name, how he can reach you and what you want, and he gets it.

choices.label: Show me a demo first
choices.why: See an agent at work for a business like yours.

choices.label: Not now
choices.why: The contact page has his mail, WhatsApp and phone whenever you like.
